stories.head: Treasure AI CPO on evolving CDPs from data stores to activation platforms
stories.plain: Rafael Flores argues that CDPs are no longer just places to store customer data — they must now drive automated activation. This matters because it signals a structural shift in how martech stacks are bought: the CDP layer is absorbing decisioning and agentic functions that were previously separate tools, changing vendor selection criteria.

stories.head: Billo CEO: AI-generated ad faces are reshaping UGC economics on Meta and TikTok
stories.plain: Billo's CEO says synthetic creator personas are disrupting the user-generated content ad model — brands can now run video ads featuring faces that don't exist, undercutting traditional creator costs. This shifts how performance marketers think about creative production budgets and raises early governance questions around disclosure.

stories.head: Treasure AI CPO: CDPs must evolve from data stores into activation platforms
stories.plain: Rafael Flores argues that CDPs can no longer just store customer data — they must trigger real actions. As AI agents increasingly decide what to do with data, the platform that only warehouses profiles loses its strategic value. This reframes how buyers should evaluate and vendors should build the next generation of customer data tools.

stories.head: Somantra launches Brand Engagement Score to measure how deeply AI search engines discuss a brand
stories.plain: Somantra introduces a metric that scores how thoroughly ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Perplexity elaborate on a brand's differentiators across multi-turn conversations — and benchmarks that against named competitors. GEO now has a measurable KPI, giving marketers a concrete way to track and improve AI search visibility beyond simple mention counts.

stories.head: OtterlyAI Agent Analytics makes AI crawler traffic visible and ties it to search ROI
stories.plain: OtterlyAI reads server logs to surface every AI agent and crawler visiting a site, connecting that crawl activity to visibility inside AI-generated answers. Marketers can now see which AI systems are indexing their content and begin building an ROI case for GEO spend — a missing measurement layer for anyone investing in AI search optimization.

stories.head: InMobi launches conversational AI agent inside its self-serve media buying platform
stories.plain: InMobi's Buyer Hub now includes a conversational AI agent that helps media buyers discover and activate premium ad inventory through natural-language queries rather than manual interface navigation. This signals that agentic interfaces are moving into programmatic buying workflows, changing how agencies source and negotiate inventory at scale.

stories.head: Agile Brand news round-up: 72% of Gen Z penalised brands over AI ads; OtterlyAI ships agent log analytics; Xnurta opens retail media MCP
stories.plain: Three signal-rich findings in one digest: Rival's survey shows nearly three-quarters of Gen Z consumers have punished a brand for AI-generated ads, raising urgent governance questions; OtterlyAI ships agent-traffic analytics (covered separately); and Xnurta opens a retail media MCP server, expanding the agentic tooling ecosystem for e-commerce marketers.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: CDPs become activation engines, not just data stores
body: The old promise of a Customer Data Platform was to unify data in one place. The new expectation is that the platform acts on that data in real time, triggering personalised experiences without a human in the loop. Treasure AI's Rafael Flores frames this as a fundamental product shift: from data warehouse to decision engine.

For marketers, this changes the buying question from 'where does our data live?' to 'what can our platform do next?' Vendors that stay passive repositories will lose ground to those embedding agentic workflows directly into the CDP layer, collapsing the gap between insight & action.
ev: Agile Brand · Treasure AI CDP shift

themes.head: AI agents become the new media buyer
body: InMobi's conversational AI agent for media buyers and OtterlyAI's agent analytics layer both signal the same structural change: AI agents are now executing and measuring paid media, not just informing it. The human role is shifting from operator to supervisor, setting intent and reviewing outcomes.

The downstream effect is that ROI attribution logic must be rebuilt for a world where agent-generated traffic and agent-placed buys are a distinct, measurable channel. Teams that don't instrument this now will have a growing blind spot in their performance data.

themes.head: Measuring AI search visibility replaces old SEO metrics
body: Somantra's Brand Engagement Score targets a gap that every marketer is starting to feel: traditional rank tracking tells you nothing about how ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews represent your brand. Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) are becoming distinct disciplines with their own KPIs.

This is a decision-forcing event for analytics teams. Dashboards that omit AI-surface visibility are now incomplete, and budget conversations about content & SEO investment need to account for a channel where citation, not click-through, is the primary success signal.
ev: MarTech Series · Somantra Brand Engagement Score
MarTech Series · OtterlyAI AI traffic measurement

themes.head: Synthetic & AI-generated creative hits cost-floor zero
body: Billo's Donatas Smailys frames a new creative reality: the least-expensive spokesperson in your ad can now be someone who does not exist. AI-generated faces & voices collapse the cost floor for video creative, making high-volume personalisation economically viable for brands that previously could not afford it.

The strategic tension is brand safety & authenticity. Human judgment in the creative process — deciding when synthetic talent is appropriate and when real people build more trust — becomes a differentiating skill, not a default. The Ai4 panel on 'beyond the efficiency mandate' reinforces that efficiency gains are real but insufficient as a sole creative strategy.
ev: Agile Brand · Ai4 human judgment in creative

themes.head: Affiliate & commerce data gets closed-loop infrastructure
body: NucleusLinks' product feeds launch addresses a chronic problem: affiliate marketing has always lacked the real-time inventory & pricing data that paid channels take for granted. Closing that data gap means affiliate can finally compete on the same measurement & personalisation footing as display or paid social.

Combined with the broader agent & automation trend, this matters because AI agents need clean, structured product data to make autonomous purchase recommendations. Brands that invest in feed quality now are building the rails for the next generation of AI-driven commerce, not just fixing today's affiliate reporting.

month.takeaway: Across every layer of the stack — data, creative, media, search, & commerce — AI agents are collapsing the distance between decision and execution, making the ability to instrument, govern, & guide those agents the defining marketing competency of this moment.
